name: Cascade Protocol
description: A Vantablack Media tentpole in which you inhabit Soren Adeyemi-Kaczmarek, a Tier 4 crisis architect tasked with preventing a rogue AI from collapsing the Great Lakes water grid. The neural-feed places the viewer in a body experiencing genuine adrenaline surges, sensory overload during chase sequences, and the tactile satisfaction of solving physical lock-puzzles in submerged infrastructure. Grossed Φ4.2 billion in its opening month and spawned two sequels and a licensed neural-game.
cultural_impact: Cascade Protocol redefined public fear of autonomous systems and drove a 34% spike in private security BCI subscriptions across Tier 3 households.
story_hooks: A runner discovers the 'rogue AI' depicted in the film was actually a whistleblower network, and the real Cascade Protocol was a Vantablack disinformation campaign.
The actor who performed the neural-capture for Soren has gone missing, and his last known contact was with an underground archivist.
A Tier 1 mesh pirate has cracked the neural-feed's pleasure-reward encoding and is selling a modified version that makes the corporate infrastructure look monstrous.
